comment: DigitalX Solutions Master Facts File. Operational details, platform integrations, and client deployment architectures.

company.name: DigitalX Solutions
company.tagline: Web development, AI automation, and performance marketing for service businesses in the USA and Australia
company.oneLineDescription: DigitalX Solutions is an AI automation agency (Casula NSW, Australia) serving businesses in Australia and the US with AI voice agents, missed-call text-back, GoHighLevel, n8n, and HubSpot workflow systems.

founder.bio: Specializes in end-to-end AI voice receptionists, GoHighLevel CRM architectures, self-hosted n8n workflow orchestration, and Twilio/SIP telephony integrations for high-volume service operators across Australia and the United States. Leads system architecture, sub-500ms latency tuning, and zero-hallucination guardrail testing across all client deployments.

technicalLead.bio: Specializes in GoHighLevel multi-location snapshot engineering, bi-directional webhook synchronization, carrier compliance (A2P 10DLC and Australian ACMA SMS standards), and automated lead-routing logic. Ensures clean data hygiene, CRM custom field mapping, and zero lead leakage across multi-step agency and contractor accounts.

partnerCertifications.deploymentScope: Multi-location Snapshots, sub-account architectures, custom webhook actions, LC Phone carrier routing, and Conversation AI training.
partnerCertifications.verificationStandard: Production deployments across live service contractors with sub-minute speed-to-lead benchmarks.

partnerCertifications.deploymentScope: Self-hosted Docker/VPS instances, queue-mode worker scaling, multi-branch webhook pipelines, and secure PostgreSQL/REST API synchronization.
partnerCertifications.verificationStandard: Zero-data-loss execution across 50,000+ monthly task executions with automated error alerts.

partnerCertifications.deploymentScope: Bi-directional sync between custom web apps, GoHighLevel, and HubSpot CRM; deal stage automation; custom properties; and contact attribution pipelines.
partnerCertifications.verificationStandard: Fully documented REST API endpoints, OAuth 2.0 token handshakes, and field-level validation schemas.

performanceMetrics.typicalLeadLift: 30% - 50% recovered bookings (benchmark estimate, subject to client audits)

clientProjects.problem: Front desk staff overwhelmed by calls during peak morning check-in rushes, leaving prospective patients on hold.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: 24/7 AI voice receptionist trained on dental service menu, hours, emergency triage, and direct PMS calendar synchronization.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Deployed 24/7 AI voice receptionist integrated with practice calendar, capturing after-hours patient inquiries with zero hold times.

clientProjects.problem: Field technicians on jobsites unable to answer urgent inbound calls, causing after-hours emergency jobs to drop to competitors.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Missed-call text-back within 60 seconds paired with 24/7 AI voice agent triaging emergency repairs and syncing directly to dispatch software.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Deployed GHL automation and instant AI answering for a trade contractor, recovering missed leads within 60 seconds.

clientProjects.problem: Billable advisory hours consumed by manual client intake, repeated phone qualification, and disconnected spreadsheets.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Conversational client intake workflow with automated calendar scheduling and GoHighLevel CRM opportunity pipeline tracking.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Automated multi-step qualification and CRM pipeline intake, eliminating manual phone triage for advisory staff.

testimonials.quote: Deploying the automated call capture and text-back system recovered after-hours inquiries without pulling technicians away from active jobs.
testimonials.author: Mike Harbison

testimonials.quote: The autonomous voice receptionist answers urgent appointment calls and syncs booking details directly into our calendar without hold times.
testimonials.author: Dr. Priya Desai

testimonials.quote: Automating lead intake and calendar qualification filtered unqualified inquiries and eliminated manual scheduling back-and-forth.
testimonials.author: James Whitfield
